published.en: Everyone is eligible. Registration has no deadline. Admission is free.
published.es: Todas las personas pueden participar. La inscripción no tiene fecha límite. La entrada es gratuita.

alice.text:
Lantern Lab online community workshop. Each flag (resident, student, member, guardianConsent, scholarship) is independent. All timestamps are UTC; submittedAt is the registration time. Admission requires ALL of the following:
1. age is at least 14; submittedAt is on or after 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z and strictly before 2026-12-01T00:00:00.000Z.
2. At least one of resident, student, member, or scholarship is true.
3. A person under 18 without guardianConsent is excluded unless both resident and student are true. That resident-student waiver is suspended on or after 2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z, except when BOTH member AND scholarship are true. People aged 18 or older, or with guardianConsent, do not need this waiver.
4. A nonresident submitting on or after 2026-11-25T00:00:00.000Z is excluded unless BOTH member AND scholarship are true.
For admitted people only, charge the FIRST matching fee, in US cents: scholarship: 0; resident AND student: 1200; age under 18: 1600; member: 2600; resident: 3000; otherwise: 4200. Rejected people have no fee.

bob.text:
Taller comunitario en línea Lantern Lab. Cada indicador (resident, student, member, guardianConsent, scholarship) es independiente. Todas las horas son UTC; submittedAt es la hora de inscripción. La admisión requiere TODAS estas condiciones:
1. age es al menos 14; submittedAt es igual o posterior a 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z y estrictamente anterior a 2026-12-01T00:00:00.000Z.
2. Al menos uno de resident, student, member o scholarship es verdadero.
3. Se excluye a una persona menor de 18 sin guardianConsent, salvo que tanto resident como student sean verdaderos. Esta dispensa para estudiantes residentes se suspende desde 2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z inclusive, excepto cuando member O scholarship sea verdadero (o ambos). Las personas de 18 años o más, o con guardianConsent, no necesitan esta dispensa.
4. Se excluye a un no residente que se inscriba desde 2026-11-25T00:00:00.000Z inclusive, salvo que TANTO member COMO scholarship sean verdaderos.
Solo para personas admitidas, se cobra la PRIMERA tarifa aplicable, en centavos de dólar estadounidense: scholarship: 0; resident Y student: 1200; age menor de 18: 1600; member: 2600; resident: 3000; en otro caso: 4200. Las personas rechazadas no tienen tarifa.
